name: Baked Bean Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup cooked black beans, lightly mashed
1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp chilli powder
Sauce: 1 cup tomato passata, 1 garlic clove, 1 tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp oregano
steps: Simmer the sauce ingredients for 8 minutes.
Cook the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, then mix with the beans, corn, spices and salt.
Warm the tortillas, fill with the bean mixture, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour over the sauce, scatter the cheese and bake for 20 minutes. Top with coriander.
note: Corn tortillas are lighter in carbohydrate than large flour wraps; beans carry the protein and fibre.
